svg.desc: Source-pinned proposed flow documentation. Witness centre x: 840 mm; Witness axis height: 105 mm; Witness generic radius: 28 mm; Witness generic axial length: 50 mm. Dimensions are stipulated source layout or explicit user annotations, not measured component specifications.

PROPOSED / SOURCE-STIPULATED GEOMETRY · NOT MANUFACTURING OR PHYSICAL VALIDATION
Conceptual observation map · block positions are not apparatus dimensions

w is a separately calibrated witness-equivalent voltage; it is not automatically the raw pickup reading.
